description: §31.2 + §12.2 Trigger 5, a 3-cycle mixing placements: db-touching `down` (server-placed, Trigger 1) → plain `a` → plain `b` → `down`. `a` and `b` are referenced only by server-placed functions (each other's referrer is itself inherited — the greatest fixpoint), so both are server-placed by inheritance and every call of the cycle runs in place. down(2) → a(1) → 10 + b(1) → 110 + down(0) → 110 + u.id = 111. RUNTIME, sqlEngine "real".
rationale: §31.2 (S479): 'A cycle of calls between functions … is recursion, not a dependency cycle. The compiler SHALL NOT reject it.' §12.2 Trigger 5: 'called only from server-classified callers and never from a client-classified function, SHALL escalate to server by inheritance' — 'whole-program analysis applied at the call-graph fixed-point'.
